description:
Revenue Operations at PointClickCare partners directly with the Commercial Leadership Team, spanning Deal Desk, GTM Strategy, Revenue Enablement, and Continuous Improvement, as well as providing quoting, forecasting, analytics, and reporting support. This role sits within that team as the dedicated Rev Ops partner to an assigned Commercial vertical, directly supporting the SVP/General Manager and senior Sales leader, as well as broader Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services teams within the vertical. This role partners closely with cross-functional peers across Finance, Product, and Marketing, and within internal Revenue Operations teams. The Revenue Operations Partners pair deep analytical rigor with hands-on executive support. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape best practices across forecasting and planning, as well as providing hands-on support with complex quoting, opportunity management, and driving efficiencies through AI and automation, to focus on providing strategic insights to the leaders of this vertical. 
 
The Sr. Revenue Operations Manager serves as the dedicated partner to an assigned Commercial Leadership Team (CLT) vertical, acting as the primary interface between the GM, Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Service leadership with the broader Rev Ops function. This role exists to drive forecasting discipline, business review readiness, annual planning, and data integrity for its aligned segment, while serving as a strategic advisor to the GM and commercial leadership in this vertical on performance, risk, and opportunity. This role also drives continuous improvement in Rev Ops processes, standards, and transparency across the forecast-to-close lifecycle. 
 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Act as the trusted Revenue Operations business partner to an assigned vertical (e.g., Senior Living, Acute & Payer, etc.), serving as a right hand to the GM and Commercial leaders in that vertical by providing day-to-day operational support and strategic counsel, challenging existing thinking, and helping leaders make better decisions and drive execution
  • Manage the sales forecasting cadence for the aligned segment, ensuring forecasts are current and accurate, and own the quarterly reforecasting process; build a consolidated view of pipeline, bookings, and attainment for leadership and the CRO
  • Prepare and review weekly/monthly forecast and pipeline reports, proactively following up on deals requiring clarification and providing insight on forecast quality
  • Support and help drive the leadership team's operating cadence, including weekly business reviews, MBRs/QBRs, and executive leadership meetings (Executive Committee updates, Commercial Leadership Team (CLT) offsites, etc.); develop agendas, executive-ready speaking points, presentations, dashboards, and pre-read materials, while coordinating priorities, tracking decisions, driving follow-through, and ensuring outstanding items are resolved to drive alignment and accountability
  • Serve as an escalation point for deal/quote related questions, recommending actions on approvals and making decisions within scope, partnering with Deal Desk and Finance on complex deal structuring
  • Partner with the GM and Commercial leadership to advance key strategic initiatives, coordinating cross-functional efforts, tracking milestones, and helping remove barriers to execution
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance (churn reporting, PS revenue, cost forecasts, etc.) and Resource Management Office (RMO) for PS resourcing and capacity planning to deliver timely insights to Commercial leadership. Analyze business performance across bookings, pipeline, sales productivity, and key commercial KPIs to identify trends, surface risks and opportunities, and recommend actions and influence decisions to improve execution and results

Annual & Strategic Planning

  • Drive and coordinate the annual planning process for the aligned segment, providing strategic input and partnering with Sales leadership, Finance, HR, and the broader Rev Ops team on the plan, including budgeting, quota setting, territory and account planning, and compensation plan design
  • Support headcount and capacity planning and reporting for the aligned segment, including hiring, onboarding, and resource allocation recommendations
  • Contribute segment-level inputs to topline planning (e.g., FY budget, LRP alignment) and flag risks or dependencies, such as new product timing, that could affect the plan

Data Integrity, Salesforce Governance & Process Improvement

  • Drive data quality and governance (opportunity, pipeline, and forecast data) in Salesforce.com for the aligned vertical; proactively identify and resolve discrepancies
  • Partner with vertical Sales leadership and broader Rev Ops team to drive Salesforce adoption, data hygiene, and consistent use of sales process stages
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate forecasting, reporting, and lead/deal processes; partner with the Continuous Improvement team to prioritize, and be accountable for driving implementation, ensuring progress and follow-through and contributing directly to execution where appropriate
  • Provide strategic counsel to the GM and Sales leadership on sales process design, challenging existing thinking and continuously evaluating best practices at other high-growth SaaS companies

Leadership & Enablement

  • Set priorities, allocate workload, and ensure high-quality, timely support to GM and Commercial team leadership
  • Partner with the Revenue Enablement team on onboarding and ongoing enablement content for the Sales team
  • Support cross-functional planning events (GTM Kick off, CLT offsites), gathering inputs and preparing content in partnership with Sales, Marketing, and Product leadership, as well as partners within the broader Rev Ops team
  • Collaborate with fellow Revenue Operations Business Partners to ensure consistent, scalable support models across verticals, and share best practices and insights to strengthen the overall team

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

  • Act as a connective link between the Commercial teams and FP&A, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, as well as GTM teams
  • Prepare concise, executive-ready summaries of segment performance, risks, and recommendations for vertical senior leadership
  • Represent segment perspectives in Rev Ops leadership discussions, and represent Rev Ops priorities and standards back to vertical leadership
  • Support M&A integration activities as needed, including data, process, and systems alignment

 

Qualifications & Skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 8–10 years of relevant business experience, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or technology company
  • Demonstrated experience managing operations and complex processes, with at least 2+ years in a people leadership or cross-functional partnership capacity
  • Experience working closely with senior cross-functional executives and leadership teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, decision-ready insight for senior stakeholders
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; strong working knowledge of Salesforce.com

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or a Master's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
  • Experience partnering directly with a CRO or senior Commercial Leadership Team
  • Experience supporting executive-level decision making
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes, billing models, and contract structures
  • SaaS and/or healthcare technology industry experience
